caption: The color imbalance of a stump pair is ±2.
content: A pair of stumps is always placed on cells with the same @g{tips/complete_block/common/parity}{parity}. Therefore, the color imbalance of a stump pair is +2 if both stumps are on @m{true}, and -2 if both are on @m{false}.

content.caption: Example
content: Let's think about how to re-solve this Area so as to @g{rule/complete_forest/flower}{make flowers bloom on all roads}.

For example, if you form a stump pair as follows, the color imbalance of this stump pair is -2. As a result, you need to create another terrain with a color imbalance of +2 to compensate for the mismatch in color imbalance.

There is not enough room to draw two roads with a color imbalance of +1, so instead you need to create a stump pair with a color imbalance of +2. To avoid wilting the flowers, you need to split the road with an empty lot so that each stump pair is on a separate road, which leads to the tile placement shown as follows.
